meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 提供产品名称、卖点、目标用户后，它会按产品类型选模板，生成带 emoji 的标题和四段正文（痛点—产品—卖点—情感），输出 Markdown 文案；也能改写你已有的电商文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求时接管，比如要为商品写图片文案，或改进已有文案的标题、正文、emoji。

say.text: 帮我为一款智能睡眠眼罩写电商文案，卖点是科学遮光、智能感应光线
say.note: 会生成带 emoji 的标题和四段正文

say.text: 把这条充电宝的标题改得更有吸引力，加个产品昵称
say.note: 会重写标题并配上相关 emoji

say.text: 这是我写的护肤品文案，帮我优化痛点描述和 emoji
say.note: 会分段改写问题点、调整 emoji

howto.what_en: Given a product name, selling points and target users, it picks a category template, writes an emoji title and a four-part body (pain point, product, selling points, emotional close), and outputs Markdown copy. It can also rewrite existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copywriting or optimization, such as product image copy, or improving an existing title or body.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for a smart sleep mask; selling points: light blocking
say_en.note: Produces an emoji title and four-part body

say_en.text: Make this power bank title more eye-catching and add a product nickname
say_en.note: Rewrites the title and adds related emoji

say_en.text: Here is my skincare copy; optimize the pain-point lines and the emoji
say_en.note: Rewrites problem areas and adjusts emoji
